name: lovedone-soft-mcp
stderr:
LovedOne Soft MCP (sandwich-soft-mcp) needs SANDWICH_SOFT_API_KEY.
Mint a sk-sand-… key at:
  https://soft.lovedone.app (portal → Settings → MCP keys)

Sign in to the LovedOne Soft portal → Settings → MCP keys (owner or admin). Copy the plaintext once (sk-sand-…). A LovedOne Family key will not work here.
Then set:
  SANDWICH_SOFT_API_KEY=sk-sand-…
This CLI only talks to https://api.lovedone.app/mcp/vendor/v1.
Docs: https://docs.joinsandwich.com/mcp-vendor.html
